notes: The desktop dashboard is visually polished, with excellent hierarchy, strong chart composition, clear denominators and prominent source attribution.
The year and district controls are easy to discover, and the final download control is prominent.
At 390 px the document is 238 px wider than the viewport; charts and the provenance table create horizontal overflow and clipped content.
Unsupported status bands are encoded in labels and colour, while percentage-point gains are labelled as percentages.
The final page still shows 2022 rows and does not surface Purnia as the turn-two lowest-district answer.
The page depends on remote Chart.js and font assets, so the strongest visual elements are not offline-safe.
